summary: Latency-sensitive first-finish testing for Uplaud.AI business page. All 11 backend endpoints and all 9 frontend UI flows tested end-to-end against the public URL. Backend seeds business + reviews + case studies on startup, MongoDB read/write functional. Frontend redirect, hero, trust badges, insights, review filters/search/sort, case studies, case study detail, and share form all working. No blockers found.
passed: GET /api/business/the-solved-skin returns name, vertical health-wellness, total_reviews 666, avg_rating 4.6
GET /api/business/the-solved-skin/stats returns trust_score 94, unique_reviewers 612, rating_distribution, sentiment, keywords
GET /reviews returns 12 seeded reviews with all required fields (id, reviewer_name, rating, emoji, text, date, verified, referred)
GET /reviews?rating=5 filters to 7 five-star reviews (all rating=5 verified)
GET /reviews?sort=top sorts descending: [5,5,5,5,5,5,5,4,4,4,3,3]
GET /reviews?q=acne returns 7 reviews all containing 'acne'
GET /reviews?referred_only=true returns 6 reviews all with referred=true
GET /case-studies returns 3 case studies with expected slugs
GET /case-studies/{cs_slug} returns full case study with body_html
POST /reviews creates new review, returns success:true with new UUID
GET /api/business/nonexistent-slug returns 404
Root / redirects to /business/the-solved-skin
Hero renders 'The Solved Skin', trust card shows 94, 4.6, 666
4 trust badges rendered without duplicates
Insights: rating-distribution, sentiment-card, keywords-card all visible
13 review cards render (12 seeded + 1 from prior POST test)
Rating filter '5' narrows cards to 8 (7 seeded 5-star + 1 test)
Search 'acne' narrows to 7 cards
Referred toggle narrows to 6 cards
Sort dropdown accepts 'top'
Share form submit shows share-success state
3 case study cards navigate to /business/:slug/blog/:csSlug
Case study detail page renders cs-title, cs-body, cs-back-link
notes: Minor observation (non-blocking): the 'All' rating filter pill does not have data-testid='filter-rating-all' (uses different id/text). Tests worked around by reloading. Consider adding for future test stability. No dark-on-dark text issues observed on hero, insights, reviews, or case study pages.
